chain.title: Green Rust
chain.desc: Scrape the green patina off weathered, exposed or oxidized copper with an axe - Verdigris is the humble reagent your first alchemical recipes call for.

chain.title: Toil and Trouble
chain.desc: Craft the Alembic, the manual still that boils items down into materia - the essences and admixtures every machine in this mod runs on.

chain.title: A Clean Workshop is a Safe Workshop
chain.desc: Distilling leaves Alchemical Waste caked in the Alembic. Craft a Cleaning Brush and scrub it out - the waste itself becomes an ingredient later, so keep it.

chain.title: Gloopy Sauce Jars
chain.desc: Craft Materia Jars to bottle your distilled substances. Machines pull materia straight from jars placed nearby, so a wall of them is your first storage system.

chain.title: The Reference Section
chain.desc: Offer a Codex Arcana to the Wandering Wizard and receive the Codex Materia - the in-game encyclopedia of every materia and how to distill it.

chain.title: Thy Brush, The Circle
chain.desc: Craft the Circle of Fabrication, which slowly paints items into existence from materia - alchemical crafting without touching a crafting table.

chain.title: Join the Rotary Club
chain.desc: The Circle of Fabrication needs power. Craft a Circle of Toil and set a Wickerwood Construct walking it to crank out Eldrin power the slow, honest way.

chain.title: Reference Material
chain.desc: Create the Sublimation Primer, your guide to the Ritual of the Balanced Scales - the manaweaving ritual behind every tier-gating material in the mod.

chain.title: Metal Without, Prism Within
chain.desc: Perform the Ritual of the Balanced Scales to make Iris Argenti, the prismatic silver that unlocks the Circle of Power and the next rank of devices.

chain.title: The Ideal Alloy
chain.desc: Balance gold against silver in the Ritual of the Balanced Scales to create Perfected Electrum - the alloy the Nexus, the Skywrath Altar and all master-tier gear are built from.

chain.title: Progress is Rarely Easy
chain.desc: Combine the Balanced Scales ritual with a Runic Anvil to forge the Magichemical Mechanism, the clockwork heart of the Alchemical Nexus.

chain.title: A Philosopher's Machine
chain.desc: Build the Alchemical Nexus, the multiblock centerpiece that crafts catalysts, relics and everything the lesser circles cannot - your lab now has an endgame bench.

chain.title: Ex Nihilo
chain.desc: Craft the Conjurer for an unlimited trickle of simple raw materials - stone, sand and the like conjured from nothing, feeding your automation forever.

chain.title: No More Furnace Loading
chain.desc: Replace the hand-fed Alembic with the Distillery, an Eldrin-powered machine that distills continuously and accepts actuator upgrades.

chain.title: We Should Improve Devices Somewhat
chain.desc: Craft the Proto Actuator, the blank upgrade module. Refined into elemental forms - Deluge, Gale, Inferno, Quake - it makes your devices faster, cheaper or cleaner.

chain.title: Machine Revolution
chain.desc: Craft the Centrifuge to spin admixtures apart into their component essentia - the separation half of the alchemical loop.

chain.title: The Freedom to Combine
chain.desc: Craft the Fusery to fuse essentia back into admixtures of your choosing - with Centrifuge and Fusery together, materia becomes fully convertible currency.

chain.title: Wondrous Magical Voltage
chain.desc: Craft the Circle of Power, an Iris Argenti ring that generates serious Eldrin power from Grains of Quicksilver - the Circle of Toil's retirement party.

chain.title: Wireless Extension Cords
chain.desc: Craft Power Spikes to beam energy from your Circle of Power to distant devices - lay out the lab however you like.

chain.title: Next Best Thing to Creative Mode
chain.desc: Upgrade to the Grand Circle of Fabrication, which drinks Circle of Power voltage to fabricate items at scale. Feed the Circle a Focusing Catalyst, Amplifying Prism and Auxiliary Circle Array to push it further.

chain.title: The Sizzling Means It's Working
chain.desc: Craft the Acid Basin, an open vat for soaking items in Aqua Vitae and worse - the entry point to crystal perfection, wine-mulling and acid-etched recipes.

chain.title: Prismatic Perfection
chain.desc: Perform the eight-step refinement - basin baths, sublimation and all - to perfect a Vinteum Crystal shard. The Immaculate crystal is the lens the Astral Observer demands.

chain.title: Lightborne Secrets of the Cosmos
chain.desc: Build the Astral Observer to read the sky and press starlight into Horoscopes - solar and lunar charms of fortune you can even corrupt into foreboding curses.

chain.title: To Transcend the Work of Atlas
chain.desc: Forge a Solar, Lunar and Sidereal Orb and unite them into the Celestial Mechanism - a captive model of the heavens and the core of the Orrery.

chain.title: A God Am I
chain.desc: Create the Eldrin Orrery and harvest Eldrin power from its false planet - a top-tier generator that spins a private cosmos for you.

chain.title: Power Unbound
chain.desc: Raise the Skywrath Altar from Perfected Electrum and call lightning down on demand - Fulmination turns enchanted books into Scorched Theorems and charges Thunderstones.

chain.title: Slumbering Potential
chain.desc: Create the Inert Wisdom Stone at the altar, then walk it through the great work - Nigredo, Albedo, Citrinitas, Rubedo - each stage a stronger philosopher's charm.

chain.title: A River of Many Colors
chain.desc: Build the Grand Distillery multiblock, the master-tier still that processes whole stacks into rivers of materia and unlocks the Grand Centrifuge and Grand Fusery.

chain.title: Full-Scale Automated Production
chain.desc: Craft the Laboratory Charm to open six actuator ports on a Grand device - the final word in automated alchemy.

notes: Alchemy-machine mod tightly integrated with Mana and Artifice (jar ships data/mna manaweaving patterns and rituals; Ritual of the Balanced Scales, Runic Anvil, Wickerwood Constructs and the Wandering Wizard are all mna mechanics - gate this chain after early mna). Order taken verbatim from the jar's 80-file advancement tree (data/magichem/advancements: root->alembic->cleaning->materia_jar; sublimation_primer->iris_argenti->circle_power->power_spike->grand_circle_fabrication; sublimation_primer->perfected_electrum->magichemical_mechanism->alchemical_nexus->distillery->centrifuge/fusery->grand_distillery->laboratory_charm; acid_basin->immaculate_vinteum_crystal->astral_observer->celestial_mechanism->eldrin_orrery; skywrath_altar->wisdom stones), with the composite _t1-_t4 lab advancements confirming the intended lab tiers. All 29 chain + 33 collection ids verified against the 391 item/block lang stems. Advancement titles reused where they were already good. Note traveler's compass id is travellers_compass (double L). craft_a_relic (one-per-world relic on the Nexus) left out of the chain since the choice is personal; horoscope_solar_foreboding/lunar_foreboding exist if a corruption quest is wanted.
